title: 霓虹還沒關
subject: a city that never turns its lights off
caption: 80s Japanese-style city pop sung in Mandarin. Funky sixteenth-note rhythm guitar, a Rhodes electric piano comping jazzy chords, slap bass, warm analog synth pads and a short synth-brass hit on the chorus. A husky female lead sings smoky and laid-back, sitting behind the beat, with light stacked harmonies on the hook. Warm analog saturation, wide stereo image, gated reverb on the snare. 104 BPM, E-flat major. Nostalgic, urban, night-drive.
lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes & Guitar]

[Verse 1]
計程車的頂燈在下雨裡發光
我沒有招手 只是站著看
玻璃上的城市在流
流成一條發亮的河

[Pre-Chorus]
十二點過後這裡才真正醒來

[Chorus]
霓虹還沒關
我就還不想回家
燈一盞一盞替我說著
那些我說不出口的話

[Verse 2]
便利商店的音樂循環第三遍
店員在擦同一塊玻璃
我們都在等一個
不會來的人

[Synth Solo]

[Chorus]
霓虹還沒關
我就還不想回家
燈一盞一盞替我說著
那些我說不出口的話

[Outro]
再走一條街
再走一條街
